long_biography.plain_text:
Brooks was the first in his family to attend university, graduating in management sciences from Manchester. His early banking career included nine years in Boston and New York, where he led corporate lending, before returning to London to build a new mezzanine-finance business.

That venture became MML Capital, now a multi-office private-equity manager. A strategic minority investment supported Brooks's retirement from the firm in 2023, freeing him to concentrate on giving and public service. The foundation he created with his wife, Elizabeth, supports education, social disadvantage and the arts; its work includes sustained backing for global-development research at Manchester. Brooks also serves on the Charity Commission board and was appointed CBE for charitable service.
